europe_now.title: UK Implicates Iran in RAF Fairford Incident
europe_now.summary: UK authorities have publicly stated that Iran was involved in an incident at RAF Fairford. The development highlights rising geopolitical tensions and security concerns impacting military installations.

sources.headline: UK says Iran involved in RAF Fairford incident

top_stories.title: Eurozone Inflation Surges
top_stories.summary: Economic pressures across the eurozone increased as inflation figures heated up faster than anticipated. Analysts are monitoring the broader macroeconomic implications of these accelerating price increases.

sources.headline: Eurozone inflation heats up faster than expected

top_stories.title: French School Protests
top_stories.summary: A wave of student demonstrations across educational institutions in France resulted in numerous arrests and dozens of injuries. Security forces responded to widespread disruptions during the protests.
